resources.string:
Six camera styles, processed on your device. DH 2++ color and monochrome are free. Each of the other four cameras is a separate one-time purchase; you can try their live previews before unlocking photography.

Tap the viewfinder to focus. Slide vertically to adjust exposure and pinch to zoom. Photos are saved to Pictures/PhyToy and can be viewed in the photo list by tapping the thumbnail. Camera settings let you choose photo quality, a composition grid, capture feedback and whether to review each shot.

Preview and photos use the same imaging engine. Their resolution, sensor processing and random noise can differ slightly. In warm conditions, preview speed adapts to keep the camera stable.

Camera styles are independent interpretations. They are not certified reproductions or endorsed by any camera manufacturer.

Engine and application: MIT License. No sample photographs from third-party websites are included.

Updated 1 October 2026

Camera access is used only while the camera screen is active, for a live viewfinder and photos you take. Frames are processed locally and released when the session closes.

Photos are saved on your device in Pictures/PhyToy. JPEG metadata includes the capture time, camera exposure and selected style; no location is requested or added. Delete photos with your system gallery. Uninstalling this app does not delete saved photos.

The app stores camera preferences, permission-request state, a local photo index and signed purchase receipts in private local storage. Receipts are used to restore and cache camera unlocks for offline use. Clearing app storage removes this local data; Google Play purchases can be restored with the same Google Play account.

Purchasing, restoring and confirming camera unlocks use Google Play Billing and require a network connection and Google Play account. Google handles payments under its own terms and privacy policy. We do not receive your card details. This app has no separate account, advertising or photo-upload service. We have not added a custom analytics service. Google Play and its Billing SDK process payment-service information under Google’s privacy policy. Photos, frames and camera preferences are not sent to us. Device logs may contain local diagnostic information; they are not uploaded automatically.

You can revoke camera access at any time in Android Settings → Apps → ToviCam → Permissions.
ToviCam uses your camera for the viewfinder and the photos you choose to take. Image processing stays on your device. Photos are saved to Pictures/PhyToy.
